20261122-physics-e6-2.goal: Apply principles of Wetin be di scientific reason why to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-e6-2.material: Wetin be di scientific reason why you must never touch electric plug or switch of home appliance with wet hand wey get water?
20261122-physics-e6-2.thinking.0: Wetin be di scientific reason why
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.prompt: Wetin be di scientific reason why you must never touch electric plug or switch of home appliance with wet hand wey get water?
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.explain: If skin wet with water, di electrical resistance of di human body go drop sharply to few tens of how e dey normally be, so even small voltage fit make deadly current flow through di body and cause electric shock accident.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.hint.0: Unlike pure water, everyday water get electrolytes wey dissolve inside.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.hint.1: Wet hand dey reduce skin resistance well well, so current dey flow easily.
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o0: Because inorganic ions wey dissolve for di water dey allow electricity to pass easily, so di danger of electric shock go increase sharply
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o1: Because water drops dey cool di plug and make am freeze
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o2: Because magnet force dey form for wet hand
20261122-physics-e6-2.s.s1.o.o3: Because electricity go evaporate all di water for di hand
